verdict.rationale: Pilot's pricing page claims an in-product AI that gives instant answers about past transactions and current cash flow and can run planning scenarios, so a built-in AI assistant exists. It is evidenced only by a single marketing line, and the actual task delegation (bookkeeping, AP/AR, tax, CFO work) is done by human experts. Missing for 10: evidence the AI can carry out tasks beyond Q&A and scenario runs, documentation of the assistant's scope and how it works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
